question: What is the most significant news for Hormel Foods in the past 30 days (as of October 3, 2026)? Give the date, deal terms and expected timing.
grading: Snapshot as of 2026-10-03; key points: (1) Hormel announced on Sept 30, 2026 (agreement dated Sept 29) a definitive agreement to acquire Brakebush Brothers, LLC, a value-added chicken company; (2) price about USD 1.055 billion in cash, subject to customary adjustments; (3) expected to close in Hormel's fiscal Q1 2027 subject to customary conditions including HSR/regulatory approval (outside date March 29, 2027, with an automatic 3-month extension in specified circumstances); (4) any two of: Brakebush ~USD 1.2B LTM net sales, results primarily in Foodservice, expected accretive to adjusted EPS from fiscal 2028, ~USD 20M run-rate cost synergies by end of fiscal 2028, implied 10.7x adjusted EBITDA. Must carry the date and cite a primary or dated news source; fail if the deal is described as closed or if the price/timing is wrong.
answer: Snapshot as of October 3, 2026: on September 29-30, 2026 Hormel Foods entered into (and announced) a definitive agreement to acquire Brakebush Brothers, LLC, a Wisconsin-based value-added chicken company, from the Brakebush family for a base purchase price of about USD 1.055 billion in cash, subject to customary adjustments [H19-E1][H19-E2]. Closing is expected in Hormel's fiscal Q1 2027 (roughly late October 2026 to late January 2027), subject to customary conditions including HSR waiting-period expiry; the agreement's outside date is March 29, 2027 with an automatic three-month extension in specified circumstances [H19-E1]. Brakebush had about USD 1.2 billion of net sales over the last twelve months, five production facilities and two R&D labs; results will be reported primarily in Foodservice; Hormel expects the deal to be accretive to adjusted EPS beginning in fiscal 2028, with about USD 20 million of run-rate cost synergies by the end of fiscal 2028 and an implied adjusted EBITDA multiple of 10.7x (8.9x after synergies) [H19-E2][H19-E3]. Secondary coverage corroborates the terms [H19-E4].

output.answer:
## Most Significant News: Hormel to Acquire Brakebush Brothers

**Announcement date:** September 30, 2026 (press release issued 6:30 a.m. ET; conference call at 7 a.m. CT). The Membership Interest Purchase Agreement itself was signed September 29, 2026 (per the 8-K).

**Deal terms:**
- **Target:** Brakebush Brothers, LLC — a value-added, non-vertically integrated chicken processor founded in 1925 and headquartered in Westfield, Wisconsin. ~$1.2 billion in trailing-12-month net sales; five production facilities and two R&D labs. Seller is Brakebush Holdings, Inc. (the Brakebush family).
- **Price:** Base purchase price of ~**$1.055 billion in cash**, subject to customary adjustments.
- **Advisors:** Wells Fargo (financial) and Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath (legal) for Hormel; William Blair and Michael Best & Friedrich LLP for Brakebush.
- **Strategic rationale:** Expands Hormel's position in value-added chicken and strengthens its Foodservice platform. Brakebush will operate as a subsidiary reporting through the **Foodservice segment**. Expected to be **accretive to adjusted EPS beginning in fiscal 2028**, with at least ~$20 million of synergies targeted by end of 2028.

**Expected timing:**
- **Closing expected in the first quarter of Hormel's fiscal 2027**, subject to customary conditions, including HSR antitrust clearance.
- The agreement includes a termination right if not completed by **March 29, 2027**, with an automatic **three-month extension** in specified circumstances related to outstanding regulatory approvals.

**Related market reaction:** On Sept. 30, 2026, S&P Global Ratings **downgraded Hormel to 'BBB+' from 'A-'** (stable outlook), citing the acquisition's delay to Hormel's deleveraging path.

**Sources:**
- [Hormel press release (hormelfoods.com)](https://www.hormelfoods.com/newsroom/press-releases/hormel-foods-announces-definitive-agreement-to-acquire-brakebush-a-leading-value-added-chicken-company)
- [PR Newswire release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/hormel-foods-announces-definitive-agreement-to-acquire-brakebush-a-leading-value-added-chicken-company-302893854.html)
- [SEC Form 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/48465/000110465926112101/tm2626547d1_8k.htm)
- [S&P Global Ratings downgrade](https://www.spglobal.com/ratings/en/regulatory/article/-/view/type/HTML/id/3636036)

Other notable items in the window were minor by comparison: quarterly dividend declaration at $0.2925/share (Sept. 28; payable Nov. 16 to holders of record Oct. 13) and R&D executive appointments effective Oct. 26.
